header: Text beside a picture, in two columns
bodytext:
The standard two-column layout. A switch swaps the sides, so bands down a page can alternate. The text column stops at 60 characters, however wide the band is.

Below 768px there is one column, with the picture first. On a phone, readers see the thing before its explanation.
caption: The picture keeps its proportions at every width.

image.alternative: Black chairs in a circle around a flip chart in a room with brick walls.
